frequency_question: How often does a formal proposal to activate or raise a structural capital buffer successfully pass through administrative friction to final implementation within a specified multi-year window?
membership_rule: Includes any formal regulatory proposal by the Federal Reserve Board to establish, activate, or adjust a macroprudential capital buffer framework (such as the CCyB or SIFI surcharges) that underwent standard notice-and-comment rulemaking. Excludes purely monetary policy interest rate adjustments and microprudential supervisory ratings.

cases.name: Countercyclical Capital Buffer Rate Decision (Initial/Maintenance at 0%)
Holistic Capital Review / Basel III Endgame Proposal

coverage_note: 4 named major capital policy rulemakings; represents the total population of post-Dodd-Frank structural capital buffer adjustments and frameworks.
known_gaps: Excludes minor technical amendments to existing capital rules that did not involve macroprudential stance changes.
skeleton: Total formal macroprudential capital framework rulemakings initiated by the Board vs. those successfully finalized without indefinite stalling.
multiplier: 4 final actions divided by 4 major policy initiatives evaluated for structural implementation success.
validity_reason: Statutory requirements for notice-and-comment rulemaking and Board governance structures change slowly, tied to the Administrative Procedure Act and the Federal Reserve Act.
